description: This file defines a React functional component named Editor for creating and editing notes. It manages state for note title, content, and UI states like saving and deleting, providing user interactions for saving, deleting, and editing notes.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles the save operation for the note, calls onSave prop with trimmed title and content, manages saving state and error handling.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles the delete operation for the note, prompts for confirmation, calls onDelete prop, manages deleting state and error handling.
